subject.title: feat(mattermost): auto-engage on replies to the bot's own thread

question: Should Mattermost reply-to-bot thread-root engagement ship on by default, without a new config option, after live proof or an explicit proof waiver?
rationale: The implementation fits the Mattermost plugin boundary, but it changes when existing requireMention/onchar rooms send agent replies and the protected maintainer PR needs owner acceptance.

options.title: Accept Default-On Parity With Proof Or Waiver
options.body: Treat bot-authored Mattermost thread roots as addressed by default, matching Slack and Telegram, and merge after live proof is captured or intentionally waived.

options.title: Make Reply-To-Bot Opt-In
options.body: Require an explicit Mattermost setting or documented strict mode before existing rooms start answering bot-root thread replies without mentions.

options.title: Pause For Broader Thread Policy
options.body: Hold this PR and fold reply-to-bot, participated-thread, and future Mattermost thread mention semantics into one owner decision.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-On Parity With Proof Or Waiver
recommendation.body: Treat bot-authored Mattermost thread roots as addressed by default, matching Slack and Telegram, and merge after live proof is captured or intentionally waived.

likelyOwner.reason: The history pass points to steipete as the strongest adjacent owner for channel policy and Mattermost monitor behavior.
